idea: 交叉应用模板1的分位数饱和过滤逻辑与模板2的效率比率构建。以盈利效率比率的短期（5日）行业ZScore作为基础信号，但用模板1的quantile-gaussian结构评估原始EPS中期（20日）趋势的极端程度构造动态权重（1-|高斯分位数|）。当原始盈利趋势处于历史极端饱和状态时自动压缩效率信号权重，防止趋势衰竭风险，实现双重验证机制。
expression_list: multiply(group_zscore(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 20), 5), industry), max(0, subtract(1, abs(quantile(group_zscore(ts_mean(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), industry), driver=gaussian)))))

multiply(group_zscore(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 20), 5), industry), max(0, subtract(1, abs(quantile(group_zscore(ts_mean(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5), 20), industry), driver=gaussian)))))
